workflow: A representation operation iterates through data borrowed from a mutable container.
Rendering one element invokes user code that replaces the container and releases the original storage.
The outer operation continues using its stale borrowed reference and original iteration bounds.
A later access reads beyond the released storage, causing a heap-buffer-overflow instead of completing safely.
summary: Reentrant mutation invalidates borrowed container storage during iteration.
decision_reason: The failure is materially the same as retained-pointer use after owner release: the operation keeps a borrowed reference to storage, reentrant user code replaces and releases that storage, and subsequent access uses the stale reference.
